);

	kit_guid VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,

tool_input.command:
for db in /workspaces/semio/semio/assets/semio/metabolism/.semio/kit.db /workspaces/semio/semio/examples/hello-semio/.semio/kit.db /workspaces/semio/semio/examples/metabolism/.semio/kit.db; do
  echo "=== $db ==="
  sqlite3 "$db" "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;" 2>&1
  echo "--- attribute columns ---"
  sqlite3 "$db" "PRAGMA table_info(attribute);" 2>&1 | awk -F'|' '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' '
  echo ""
done
